title: A Day in a Hell Corp
author: Hex
description: You're a poor devil, clumsy and lazy (Chuck Wagon), just like any other common immortal punching the clock to make a living. Your job is to torment souls. Crushed by an irate and irascible boss (Hank ThunderPants) and messed up by your jack-of-all-trades assistant (Wally Snivels), you daydream of a vacation in an earthly paradise between one torture session and the next!
